notes: Neon arcade space shooter in pygame: escalating waves of Drifter/Weaver/Gunner enemies, auto-fire, spread/rapid/shield pickups, pause, game over, and a SQLite high-score table. CLEAN: MIT; all sprites drawn in code and SFX synthesized at startup (no asset files); text uses pygame default Font(None); no bundled TTF/OTF/audio/images; no EXE/DLL/LFS. ~92K. Claim #3895.
